section.content: Present disclose provides semiconductor devices, comprising: semiconductor substrate；Gate structure is located on semiconductor substrate；Lightly doped district is located in semiconductor substrate and is located at gate structure two sides；And source configuration and drain electrode structure, it is located at gate structure two sides and is located in lightly doped district, the doping concentration of lightly doped district is less than source configuration, the doping concentration of drain electrode structure, wherein lightly doped district is formed with point defect.Based on this, the disclosure additionally provides the integrated circuit including at least two semiconductor devices.The disclosure can improve the breakdown voltage of semiconductor devices while the complexity and integrated circuit area for not increasing manufacturing process, can produce the semiconductor devices with different breakdown voltages based on same technique and not influence the working performances such as switching speed.

本公开提供了半导体器件，包括：半导体衬底；栅极结构，位于半导体衬底之上；轻掺杂区，位于半导体衬底内且位于栅极结构两侧；以及源极结构和漏极结构，分别位于栅极结构两侧且位于轻掺杂区内，轻掺杂区的掺杂浓度小于源极结构、漏极结构的掺杂浓度，其中，轻掺杂区形成有点缺陷。基于此，本公开还提供了包括至少两个半导体器件的集成电路。本公开能够在不加大制造工艺的复杂程度和集成电路面积的同时提高半导体器件的击穿电压，能基于同一工艺制造出具有不同击穿电压的半导体器件且不影响开关速度等工作性能。

Semiconductor devices and integrated circuitTechnical field

The utility model relates to technical field of semiconductors, more particularly, to semiconductor devices and integrated circuit.

Background technique

In CMOS technology, (lightly doped) structure is lightly doped and has become one of integrated circuit substantially Structure.This structure with low doping concentration is located in channel, and source electrode and/or drain electrode close to semiconductor devices, thus It is able to bear portion voltage, the thermoelectron degradation effect for preventing semiconductor devices, the influence for mitigating short-channel effect.

The source and drain doping area of semiconductor devices and substrate (or well region) form source and drain PN junction, source and drain junction depth refer to substrate (or Epitaxial layer) surface to source and drain doping area concentration be equal to substrate concentration in place of distance.For the semiconductor with light-dope structure For device, the concentration gradient of light-dope structure to source and drain PN junction transition is more slow, and the high voltage performance of the semiconductor devices is got over Good, i.e., breakdown voltage is bigger.That is, the light-dope structure of semiconductor devices is from semiconductor substrate to source and drain PN junction transition Concentration gradient determines the high voltage performance of semiconductor devices under certain condition.

Currently, with the development of CMOS technology, device size is gradually reduced.In order to mitigate short-channel effect, improve and partly lead The a few thing performance of body device, need that correspondingly source and drain junction depth and light-dope structure shoal (such as in 45nm-CMOS logic In technique, the depth of light-dope structure has been less than 20nm) so that semiconductor devices has faster switching speed and smaller leakage Electric current.In order to realize shallower source and drain junction depth and light-dope structure, only allow use very short in the manufacturing process of semiconductor devices Rapid thermal annealing process activation source and drain doped region and light-dope structure in impurity element.

In some applications, it is often necessary to formed while forming standard/low-voltage semiconductor device with certain high pressure resistant The high-voltage semi-conductor device of performance.If directlying adopt above-mentioned existing semiconductor fabrication process forms high-voltage semi-conductor device, The rapid thermal annealing process of short time can only form shallower source and drain junction depth and light-dope structure, nothing in high-voltage semi-conductor device Method reach desired breakdown voltage (such as directly using standard 55nm-CMOS logic process manufacture high-pressure MOS component, only have Have the breakdown voltage of 19V or so), to be unable to satisfy high pressure resistant requirement；If extending on the basis of above-mentioned manufacturing process quick The time of thermal annealing process increases additional thermal process, then source-and-drain junction deep enough is capable of forming in high-voltage semi-conductor device Deep, the concentration gradient of light-dope structure to source and drain PN junction transition is relatively slow, so that there is sufficiently large breakdown voltage, but and high pressure Semiconductor devices, which synchronizes source and drain junction depth in the standard to be formed/low-voltage semiconductor device and light-dope structure, also can correspondingly add It is deep, cause the working performances such as standard/low pressure MOS device switching speed to be deteriorated, and also increase the complicated journey of manufacturing process Degree.

Utility model content

In order to solve the above-mentioned problems of the prior art, the utility model provides a kind of semiconductor devices and integrated electricity Road can improve the breakdown potential of semiconductor devices while the complexity and integrated circuit area for not increasing manufacturing process Pressure, and can be synchronized based on identical technique and produce the semiconductor devices with different breakdown voltages and do not influence switching speed etc. Working performance.

One side according to the present utility model provides a kind of semiconductor devices, comprising: semiconductor substrate；Gate structure, On the semiconductor substrate；Lightly doped district is located in the semiconductor substrate and is located at the gate structure two sides；With And source configuration and drain electrode structure, it is located at the gate structure two sides and is located in the lightly doped district, it is described to be lightly doped The doping concentration in area is less than the source configuration, the doping concentration of the drain electrode structure, wherein the lightly doped district is formed a little Defect.

Preferably, the point defect is formed by injecting interstitial atom to the lightly doped district.

Preferably, the interstitial atom includes silicon atom.

Preferably, the injection depth of the interstitial atom and the injection depth of the lightly doped district are consistent.

Preferably, the lightly doped district extends to the lower section of the corresponding gate structure.

Preferably, the semiconductor devices include enhanced NMOS, enhanced PMOS, depletion type NMOS, depletion type PMOS, Any one of DMOS device and IGBT device.

Another aspect according to the present utility model additionally provides a kind of integrated circuit, including at least two semiconductor devices, Each semiconductor devices includes: semiconductor substrate；Gate structure is located on the semiconductor substrate；And source junction Structure and drain electrode structure are located at the gate structure two sides and are located in the semiconductor substrate, wherein described at least two Semiconductor devices includes the first semiconductor devices and the second semiconductor devices, and the breakdown voltage of first semiconductor devices is less than The breakdown voltage of second semiconductor devices, second semiconductor devices further include be located at the semiconductor substrate in and institute The lightly doped district of gate structure two sides is stated, the source configuration and drain electrode structure of second semiconductor devices are located at corresponding In the lightly doped district, the doping concentration of the lightly doped district is less than the source configuration, the doping concentration of the drain electrode structure, Point defect is formed in the lightly doped district.

Preferably, the lightly doped district is also distributed about the gate structure two sides of first semiconductor devices, described The source configuration and drain electrode structure of first semiconductor devices are located in the corresponding lightly doped district, first semiconductor Not formed point defect in the lightly doped district of device.

Preferably, each semiconductor devices includes enhanced NMOS, enhanced PMOS, depletion type NMOS, depletion type Any one of PMOS, DMOS device and IGBT device.

Point defect is formed in lightly doped district in the semiconductor devices and integrated circuit of the utility model embodiment, favorably In shortening the duration of annealing process, advantageously forming the deeper light-dope structure of junction depth, to have the advantages that The gradient concentration of lightly doped district to source and drain PN junction transition is relatively slow, improves the breakdown voltage of semiconductor devices；Due to annealing process Duration it is shorter, and point defect is not pre-formed in standard/low-voltage semiconductor device, therefore same annealing can be passed through Process, which synchronizes, produces high-voltage semi-conductor device and standard/low-voltage semiconductor device, and ensure that standard/low-voltage semiconductor simultaneously The working performance (such as with faster switching speed and lesser leakage current) of device；Increase only primary injection interstitial atom The step of, do not increase process complexity and integrated circuit area, and various nanoscales or large-sized CMOS technology can be based on It realizes.
